name: The Base
summary: Catalog of free design assets: mockups, fonts, icons, illustrations, UI kits and templates.
description: A curated catalog of free design assets across nine categories: mockups, fonts, templates, UI kits, icons, illustrations, backgrounds & textures, graphics and photos. Every asset page lists formats and license terms and points to a direct download or the author's own site; themed collections group assets for dark websites, portfolios, presentations and device mockups.
contains: 9 categories: mockups, fonts, templates, UI kits, icons, illustrations, backgrounds, graphics, photos
themed collections incl. for dark websites, for portfolio, free device mockups, icon sets, free UI kits
asset pages list formats and license terms with a direct download or a link to the author's site
authors can submit their own freebies; assets from Craftwork can be hosted on the site
